headings.usage: Use text-3xl to text-4xl for page headers (never exceed text-5xl for dashboard). Use text-xl for widget/card headings.

body.usage: Standard UI text, table content, tooltips.

data_metrics.usage: Use for all numeric data, KPIs, emissions totals, run IDs, to ensure tabular alignment and precision.

colors.background: bg-background (#F5F7F5) - Soft off-white to prevent clinical glare
colors.surface: bg-surface (#FFFFFF) - Flat solid background for data cards
colors.primary_action: bg-primary hover:bg-secondary text-primary-foreground - Use ONLY for main CTAs like 'Generate Report', 'Send Now'.
colors.accent: text-accent bg-accent/10 - Use to highlight Biogenic emissions or warnings.
colors.borders: border-border/40 (#E5E7EB with opacity) - Keep borders subtle.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) - Cardless/Flat Structural Look
grids_and_layouts.page_layout: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 p-6 lg:p-8
grids_and_layouts.sidebar_filters: col-span-1 border-r border-border/40 pr-6 h-full flex flex-col gap-6
grids_and_layouts.kpi_card: bg-surface p-4 rounded-md border border-border flex flex-col justify-between h-full hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform 0.2s ease

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid Surfaces for medical/fintech/admin data clarity. Avoid glassmorphism for data cards; use it only for sticky headers if needed.
visual_enhancers.borders: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). 1px subtle borders. Avoid heavy shadows. Use shadow-sm max.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for sharp, enterprise-ready data dashboard iconography.
visual_enhancers.data_display: Striped or subtly bordered tables for 'Report History'. Highlight the 'Biogenic' row or bar with the accent color.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.instructions: Use Shadcn Calendar and Popover. Critical for 'Reporting Period' filter. Trigger must have clear hover state.

components.name: Select/Multi-Select
components.instructions: Use for Facility, Scope, and Category filters. Use standard Shadcn Select for single, and command/badge group for multi-select.

components.name: Tabs
components.instructions: Use for switching between 'On-screen Totals', 'Report History', and 'Schedules & Delivery'. Override h-9 to h-auto to prevent cutoff.

components.name: DataTable
components.instructions: Use for MIS Report History and Delivery History. Include Run ID, Date, Parameters, and Actions (Download PDF/Excel). Hover states on rows must be distinct (hover:bg-primary/5).

components.name: Dialog / Sheet
components.instructions: Use Sheet (Right slide-out) for configuring 'Schedule Report' or 'Recipient Management' to keep context of the report visible.

components.name: Recharts
components.instructions: Use Recharts (via Shadcn Chart wrapper) for Emissions Breakdown. Use `chart-1` to `chart-5` variables. Biogenic data should use the accent color or a dashed stroke.

motion.hover_states: All buttons, table rows, and interactive elements must have transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for KPI cards and chart elements to make the dashboard feel responsive when 'Generate' is clicked.
motion.interactions: Slide-in from right for schedule config sheet. Accordion down/up for advanced filters.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against bg-background meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Provide text-shadow or solid backgrounds behind text.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.test_ids: Apply data-testid to all filters, submit buttons, export buttons, and table rows.

media.icons: Use lucide-react for action buttons (Download, Email, Schedule, Filter).
media.images: No external images needed for this MIS dashboard context, prioritizing data clarity and functional density.

third_party_libraries.export: xlsx (for Excel export), jspdf / react-pdf (for PDF export)

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Do not use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions (dropdown, calendar, toast).
Use Shadcn components for all form elements, tables, tabs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but for data cards, stick to flat design with subtle 1px borders.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.filter_behavior: Filters should not auto-submit large reports. Use an explicit 'Generate Report' button to trigger the run, preventing unnecessary API calls and allowing multi-parameter selection.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.empty_states: If no report is generated yet, show a high-quality empty state encouraging the user to select parameters and run their first Emissions Summary.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.export_actions: Export buttons (PDF, Excel) and 'Send Now' should be grouped in the top-right of the generated report view, visually distinct from the primary 'Generate' button.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.resend_integration: In the Delivery History table, clearly show the Resend delivery status (Delivered, Bounced, Opened) using small badge components with semantic colors (Green for delivered, Red for bounced).
